seo_title: PowerPoint Presentation Design Course | Nova Skills
seo_description: Learn PowerPoint Slide Master, templates, editable charts, animation and accessible slides in 4 weeks (32h). Build a design portfolio. ₹4,900.

overview.heading: What You Will Learn
overview.description: Learn to create professional PowerPoint presentations using visual hierarchy, Slide Master, layouts, editable charts, infographics, appropriate animation and consistent brand styling. Build business-ready decks through practical design and technical presentation exercises.
overview.expanded_copy_1: Learn to turn reports, business ideas and technical information into clear, professional slides. Develop practical skills in visual hierarchy, typography, alignment, custom layouts, reusable templates, editable diagrams and charts.
overview.expanded_copy_2: Build complete presentations in Microsoft PowerPoint using Slide Master, branded components, suitable animations and accessible design practices. Graduate with a twelve-slide business deck, a reusable template system and a five-slide redesign portfolio.
overview.main_value_proposition: Visual Design + Real PowerPoint Operations + Editable Client-Ready Delivery.
overview.learning_journey: Presentation Brief → Slide Structure → Visual Design → Master Layouts → Charts → Motion → Quality Review → Editable Delivery

prerequisites: Basic computer proficiency (file management, keyboard navigation, mouse controls)
No prior graphic design experience or advanced PowerPoint expertise required
target_audience: Office professionals compiling quarterly reports, strategy decks, and business reviews
College students and graduates preparing professional academic and job-interview decks
Corporate trainers and educators designing engaging, structured instructional slides
Administrative staff and executive assistants building departmental presentation decks
Marketing coordinators and sales support professionals crafting client proposals
Business owners seeking standardized, branded templates without expensive agency retainers
Designers and freelancers seeking structured presentation production and slide-design skills
learning_outcomes: Understand linked and embedded Excel charts.
Produce PDF and other suitable handover formats.
Review fonts and visual asset licenses.
Explain the limits of their chosen tools.
hands_on_tech: Microsoft PowerPoint for Microsoft 365 (Windows Desktop preferred)

modules.practical_assignment: Create a reusable corporate PowerPoint template.
modules.assessment:
A reusable PowerPoint template such as `.potx`, plus a reviewable `.pptx` demonstration where appropriate.

A `.thmx` theme may be supplied as supporting evidence.

### IMPORTANT TECHNICAL DISTINCTION

A PowerPoint theme and a PowerPoint template are related but not identical.

A theme primarily specifies coordinated colours, fonts and effects.

A template can include the theme plus master layouts, placeholders and reusable structure.

Creating and saving a custom template requires suitable desktop PowerPoint functionality.

Do not claim that PowerPoint for the web provides identical Slide Master authoring capabilities.

business_use_cases.problem: Quarterly reviews are overloaded with cluttered text, unaligned screenshots, and inconsistent fonts, losing leadership attention.

business_use_cases.problem: Sales and marketing teams use wildly divergent slide formats, diluting brand identity across client meetings.
business_use_cases.solution: Slide Master theme/template (.potx) with 5+ standardized layouts, locked master branding, and clear placeholders.

business_use_cases.problem: Legacy internal decks contain dense bullet lists and distorted 3D charts that fail to communicate complex concepts.

faq.question: What is Microsoft PowerPoint — Professional Presentation Design?
faq.answer: It is a practical PowerPoint certification focused on professional slide design, templates, editable charts, accessible presentations and business-ready file delivery.

faq.question: How long is the course?
faq.answer: Four weeks with 32 learning hours.

faq.question: What is the fee?
faq.answer: ₹4,900, subject to Nova Skills' verified pricing and tax policy.

faq.question: Is it suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. Basic computer knowledge is sufficient.

faq.question: What software will I learn?
faq.answer: Microsoft PowerPoint is the primary software.

faq.question: Will I learn visual design principles?
faq.answer: Yes, including hierarchy, typography, alignment, grids, colour and whitespace.

faq.question: What is Slide Master?
faq.answer: Slide Master controls reusable presentation layouts and consistent visual elements.

faq.question: Will I create custom PowerPoint templates?
faq.answer: Yes. The portfolio includes a reusable theme/template system.

faq.question: What is the difference between a PowerPoint theme and a template?
faq.answer: A theme defines coordinated visual styling. A template adds reusable layouts, placeholders and presentation structure.

faq.question: Will I learn professional infographics?
faq.answer: Yes, at a practical business-slide design level.

faq.question: Will I create editable diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. Students practise PowerPoint shapes, diagrams and suitable infographic layouts.

faq.question: Will I learn PowerPoint charts?
faq.answer: Yes. The course includes editable charts, tables and data presentation.

faq.question: Can I use Excel data in PowerPoint?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum covers embedding and linking Excel data where appropriate.

faq.question: What happens if a linked Excel file is moved?
faq.answer: The link may break and require updating or replacing its source.

faq.question: Will I learn animation?
faq.answer: Yes. The course covers suitable transitions, object animation and the Animation Pane.

faq.question: Will I learn Morph?
faq.answer: Yes, where supported by the available PowerPoint edition.

faq.question: Is Morph available in every PowerPoint version?
faq.answer: No. Feature support depends on the version and licensing.

faq.question: Will I learn Presenter View?
faq.answer: Yes. The course covers the technical use of speaker notes and Presenter View.

faq.question: Is public speaking included?
faq.answer: Only basic technical presentation operation. Speaking and audience interaction are covered more fully in Course 89.

faq.question: What is the difference between Course 89 and Course 104?
faq.answer: Course 89 focuses on presenting and communicating; Course 104 focuses on designing and producing slides.

faq.question: Will I learn accessible slide design?
faq.answer: Yes, including titles, contrast, reading order, alt text and accessibility review.

faq.question: Will I learn subtitles or captions?
faq.answer: The course introduces appropriate captioning workflows and platform-specific feature awareness.

faq.question: Will I learn PDF export?
faq.answer: Yes, including export quality checks.

faq.question: Will I receive editable files?
faq.answer: Editable PowerPoint files are required as part of the portfolio.

faq.question: Is Copilot required?
faq.answer: No. Copilot is optional and depends on licensing and availability.

faq.question: Can Canva or Photoshop be used?
faq.answer: Yes, for supporting visual assets, but PowerPoint remains the primary design tool.

faq.question: How many slides will I create?
faq.answer: The main portfolio requires a twelve-slide business deck and a separate five-slide before/after redesign exercise.

faq.question: What are the portfolio deliverables?
faq.answer: A twelve-slide business deck, a reusable PowerPoint theme/template and a five-slide redesign exercise.

faq.question: Who should enroll?
faq.answer: Office professionals, educators, students, business teams and designers who want better presentation-production skills.

faq.question: What can I study next?
faq.answer: Depending on goals, suitable next steps include Presentation Skills & Business Storytelling, Office Productivity Professional, Business Productivity Mastery or broader design programs. ---
